messages:
maya: Quick announcement — release train freeze starts 2026-06-15 00:00 UTC through 2026-06-17 23:59 UTC. Planned maintenance window for infra upgrades and canary validations.
maya: If you need an exception (hotfix / security patch / critical rollout) follow the exception process below — exceptions are limited and require signoff. :warning:
andre: What does signoff look like? who signs?
maya: Two approvals required: 1) Eng-SRE (capacity & risk), 2) Product/PM owning the release. Also must include a rollback plan and a test checklist. Cutoff for exception requests: 36 hours before the intended deploy.
sophie: Security patch — do we use the same flow? urgent CVE fix might need faster path.
maya: For security fixes tag your Jira ticket with EXCEPTION+SECURITY and ping @ops-oncall and @eng-sre in the thread. We accept expedited reviews but still need the minimal info (CVE, impact, quick test steps).
jay: Can we do canary deploys during the freeze?
maya: Short answer: limited canaries only with Eng-SRE signoff and a defined canary window <= 2 hours. No broad rollouts. If Eng-SRE gives canary signoff, include the canary metric targets in the request (error rate, latency, p95).
jay: What happens if the canary shows regressions?
maria: (ops-oncall): Immediate rollback if error rate >5% sustained for 5m or if latency p95 increases >30% over baseline. We will also trigger alerting runbook and notify the release channel.
release-bot: [automated] Freeze active: 2026-06-15 00:00 UTC -> 2026-06-17 23:59 UTC. Exception requests accepted until 2026-06-13 12:00 UTC.
maya: Exception request template (paste into Jira or the thread):
```
- Summary: short description
- Reason: why this needs to go during freeze
- Impact: users/services affected
- Rollback plan: step-by-step
- Tests: smoke/checklist and canary metrics
- Approvals: Eng-SRE, Product (add screenshots of approvals)
```
andre: Any special notes for Dedicated/private customers?
maya: If the change affects Dedicated or Private customers, include the customer impact section and legal/compliance signoff if data residency is affected. Also notify Customer Success.
sophie: OK thanks — I'll queue a security exception for the certificate rotation.
ops-oncall: I can triage the security exception once the ticket is up, ping me in the thread.
maya: Thanks everyone. Reminder: if in doubt, open the ticket early — it's much faster to iterate than to rush last-minute. :thumbsup:
